migrationRule: An Institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Institution dossier. Direct rows remain proposition-limited; partial rows preserve explicit locator/mapping gaps. visualRule: Derived visuals encode State context and source granularity, then terminate at the institution identity boundary. R/S/U/N context never propagates to the institution and partial rows visibly retain their evidence-curation gap.
